properties.name: log-viewer.access-log-directory
properties.description: Directory where Tomcat access log files are written. Relative paths are resolved against catalina.base (set via server.tomcat.basedir). Must be consistent with server.tomcat.basedir in the consumer app.

properties.name: log-viewer.excluded-prefixes
properties.description: URI path prefixes (after context-path is stripped) that are excluded from the Tomcat access log and written to exclusions.log instead. Default: /admin/logs, /swagger-ui, /v3/api-docs.
